lab-04-a.json.title: Set Up Meta Pixel and Google Tag via GTM
lab-04-a.json.description: In this lab, you will set up Google Tag Manager from scratch, then install both the Meta Pixel and Google Ads Conversion Tag through GTM. You will test everything using GTM's Preview Mode to ensure tags fire correctly. This is a foundational skill — without proper tracking, you cannot measure or optimize any ad campaign.

lab-04-b.json.title: Build a Meta Ads Campaign from Scratch
lab-04-b.json.description: In this lab, you will build a complete Meta (Facebook/Instagram) advertising campaign from scratch — from Business Manager setup to creating ad sets with different audiences, designing creatives, and submitting the campaign for review. You will work with a real (or simulated) ad account and learn the exact workflow used by professional media buyers.

notes-04.md.title: Module 4: Paid Advertising (Performance Marketing Deep Dive)
